answer: In this PoA design, each identity is verified by a Wesolowski VDF: a challenge seeds sequential modular squarings, and acceptance requires the output plus a succinct proof. Since every squaring depends on its predecessor, an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot split one chain across GPUs or hide its latency; each clone requires a separate physical time path. A ripple, lantern, or gale of fabricated nodes therefore cannot outrun the clock.
